daniel-bogale-anti-ai-writing-humanizer-.description: Humanizer that writes prose (or rewrites it) so it doesn't read as AI — using an editable house-rules file plus a deep detection engine. Use whenever the user wants to de-AI any writing — a chat message, DM, email, Slack reply, social caption, or a full blog post, article, newsletter, essay, or landing-page copy. Triggers on "anti-ai", "humanize this", "make this sound human", "rewrite so it doesn't sound like ChatGPT", "less AI / less ChatGPT-y", "de-AI this", "remove AI-isms", "audit this for AI tells", "do an AI-detection sweep", "why does this read like AI", or a request to WRITE…
